changelog: - Sales fixes from in-app feedback (#3976): the hand-off dialog keeps the current follow-up by default and offers it first; the lead page's stage badge wears the board column's stage color (`boardColumnPaint()`); the follow-up's date and time boxes share one baseline (`items-end`, wider time column); "Try again?" puts its two fields on one line and its actions below, so it fits a narrow card; the hand-off strip shows only the open count (and overdue when there is any) with the whole split as hover text; "New lead" is on `/sales/board` too.

en: Handing a lead over now keeps the current follow-up by default.
"New lead" is now on the board too, and the lead page shows the stage in the same color as the board.
tr: Lead devrederken mevcut takip artık varsayılan olarak korunuyor.
"Yeni lead" artık panoda da var; lead sayfası aşamayı panodaki renkle gösteriyor.
de: Beim Übergeben eines Leads bleibt die aktuelle Wiedervorlage jetzt standardmäßig erhalten.
„Neuer Lead“ gibt es jetzt auch auf dem Board, und die Lead-Seite zeigt die Phase in derselben Farbe wie das Board.
